findings.title: Undo doesn't roll back telem.foundationOrder / cellUses; ordering & cell objectives wrongly denied and count objectives inflatable
findings.failure_scenario: Home 2♥ while exploring, undo it, then win a clean aces-first line; foundationOrder still starts [2♥up] so acesFirst returns false and Gold is denied. Or park a card then undo, win cell-free, but cellUses stuck at 1 denies no-cells. Or home a King down/undo/redo repeatedly to append 4 duplicate {rank13,down} and falsely satisfy down-openers-20.
findings.rationale: snapshot() captures only tableau/cells/up/down/moveCount; undo() restores those + moveCount but never touches telem.foundationOrder or telem.cellUses. Undo is a first-class, encouraged mechanic (Replay to improve).
findings.suggested_fix: In snapshot() record foundationOrder.length and cellUses; in undo() truncate foundationOrder to that length and restore cellUses (both append-only, so length restore suffices).

status_history.validation: snapshot records pre-move foundationOrder.length+cellUses; undo truncates array + restores counter; undos correctly not rolled back; one-card-per-move invariant makes truncation exact.

findings.title: Daily overlay crashes (null deref) when todayIndex() is outside [0, pool.length)
findings.failure_scenario: Before the 2026-08-12 epoch (e.g. a user west of UTC at launch) todayIndex()=-1; openDaily sets dailyView=-1, renderDailyCard calls dailyChallenge(-1)->null, derefs c.seed -> TypeError, overlay never opens (Daily button looks dead). Same after ~2027-08-13 when todayIndex()>=366.
findings.rationale: refreshDailyBtn enables the button whenever the pool loaded, independent of date; openDaily/renderDailyCard never range-check dailyView (renderDailyCal does).
findings.suggested_fix: Guard/clamp dailyView to the available range; render an explicit 'no challenge available' state instead of dereferencing null.

status_history.validation: openDaily clamps dailyView to [0,len-1]; renderDailyCard null-guards before any deref; calendar onclick gated; playChallenge guarded. Pre-epoch & beyond-pool render without crash.

findings.title: Autoplay persists telemetry one card behind the board; reload mid-chain desyncs foundationOrder
findings.location: index.html autoplayOneStep saveGame vs recordHomed in runAutoplay step
findings.failure_scenario: During a safe-autoplay chain each step saves BEFORE the step closure appends the homed card via recordHomed. Reload mid-chain: restoreGame loads a board with a foundation card that has no foundationOrder entry; on eventual win, aces-first/down-openers-20/suit-sprint evaluate a truncated stream -> wrong tier.
findings.rationale: autoplayOneStep calls saveGame() internally before recordHomed() runs in the step. commitMove and auto-finish both save after recordHomed, so only the autoplay path desyncs.
findings.suggested_fix: Record the homed card inside autoplayOneStep (before its saveGame) and REMOVE the recordHomed() in the runAutoplay step to avoid double-counting; or saveGame() again after recordHomed in the step.

status_history.validation: recordHomed now in exactly 4 sites (commitMove, autoplayOneStep x2, stepFinish), each once/homed card; removed from runAutoplay; runs before isWon and before autoplay saveGame.

findings.title: Cell-to-cell relocation over-counts telem.cellUses
findings.failure_scenario: Move a card from one free cell to another empty cell (legal): cellUses++ fires though no new card left the tableau. park+relocate+park yields cellUses=3, denying cells-le-2 though only two cards ever occupied a cell.
findings.rationale: cellUses incremented unconditionally in tryDestCell even when selection.kind==='cell' (smartMove's cell branch is guarded; tryDestCell isn't).

status_history.validation: tryDestCell guards cellUses++ with selection.kind!=='cell'; cell->cell counts 0.

findings.title: Drift guard pins only 7 substrings; several checkers + EPOCH_DAYS unpinned
findings.failure_scenario: downOpeners20, jacksDownFirst, suitsTopDown, evaluateChallenge, the silverPool/goldPool selection, OBJECTIVES params, and EPOCH_DAYS/dayIndexFor can drift between daily.mjs and the inlined index.html copy without tripping CI.
findings.rationale: Guard whitelists a small subset; unpinned downOpeners20 and the epoch constant are exactly what's most likely edited in one copy only.
findings.suggested_fix: Pin the remaining checker bodies, the pool-selection lines, evaluateChallenge, and EPOCH_DAYS/dayIndexFor.

status_history.validation: added canon pins (jacksDownFirst/suitsTopDown/downOpeners20/silverPool/goldPool/EPOCH_DAYS/dayIndexFor/evaluateChallenge), all present verbatim; 52/52.

findings.title: HUD objViolated for down-openers-20 shows Gold live after it has failed
findings.failure_scenario: 4th down opens at move 25; live HUD keeps '·' because objViolated returns not-violated once k===4 regardless of moveIdx, while the real checker (opened<=20) already failed. UI-only; scoring correct.
findings.rationale: objViolated only checks moves>20 while k<4; once k===4 returns false unconditionally.
findings.suggested_fix: When k reaches 4, treat as violated if the opening moveIdx exceeds 20.

status_history.validation: objViolated down-openers-20 returns e.moveIdx>20 at k===4, matching the checker (20 pass, 21 violate).
